Definition: from G4862 and G5453; passive, to grow jointly:--spring up with.
BiblicalUsage: In the parable of the sower some seed falls among thorns, and the thorns spring up with it and choke it. The thorns do not attack from outside; they grow up alongside the good seed and crowd it out, which is exactly how cares and riches and pleasures work.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe thorns grow with the seed, not against it, and I hold that I must pull them early or they will choke the word in me.
